text:
sasha: heads-up — onboarding ruby-3b-int4: KV-cache outputs start diverging from fp16 baseline around token 12,200 in the long-dialog harness. repro attached. :frowning:
kevin: can you paste the minimal repro and which flags you used?
sasha: command:
```
./run_eval --model ruby-3b-int4 --prompt tests/long_dialog_32k.txt --use-kv-cache --quant-mode int4 --max-tokens 32768 --batch 1
```
results: matches fp16 until ~12.2k then responses mutate (semantic drift) — logs show kv-index offset noise
ci-bot: nightly/kvcache/regression: ruby-3b-int4 failed (3/24 checkpoints) — test id: kvr-2143 — diff snippet:
```
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
-Assistant: The capital of France is Paris.
+Assistant: Paris is located in France and...
```
maria: could be RoPE phase aliasing when kv-shrink/stride interacts with int4 packing. we've seen non-linear phase wrap when sequence crosses multiples of 8192 in other models.
alyssa: try with --kv-prefill=off and run int8 fp16 to compare. also run kv_dump to get fingerprint of prefill prefixes.
sasha: ran int8 + fp16: both stable to 32k. int4 diverges. kv_dump for failing run:
```
prefill_fingerprint: a1f4b7c2
last_kv_index: 12213
rotary_phase_checksum: 0x9f3e
```
kevin: ok can you toggle rotary-phase-scaling (set PHASE_SCALE=0.9995) and re-run? if it stabilizes it's definitely RoPE scaling.
sasha: re-run queued, test id kvr-2143-retry. will post results. :eyes:
ci-bot: queued on dedicated-gpu-pool-7, ETA ~15m
